name: Yin Yi NE01
summary: Yin Yi NE01 is GENISOM AI’s bipedal humanoid platform. It uses the company’s joint modules and motion-control technology in a compact humanlike body, with articulated arms and hands for interaction. The manufacturer positions NE01 for dynamic movement and embodied intelligence development, including research, performances and cultural or visitor-service applications. It has an official product page and public exhibition record; current delivery availability is unverified.
